messages:
Nina (Release Lead): FYI seeing a spike in embed latency on eu-dedicated since 22:45 UTC. 95th pctl up ~2x. Need a hotfix pin + expedited approval window 23:30-00:00 UTC. Impact: degraded search UX for some customers.

AlertBot: Monitor alert: service=embeddings-eu latency_p95 > 300ms (count=18).

DeployBot: Hotfix deploy prepared: release/v2.2.1-embed-latency -> env=eu-dedicated. Canary: 7% for 8m. Rollback target: v2.2.0 (commit ab12cd3). Required approvals: 3. Use `/approve` to approve.

Alex (SRE): any backend schema or infra changes? does this touch model serving config?

Ravi (ML): code change is a buffering tweak in embedding-service (TTL for cache buckets). No model file changes. Safe rollback to v2.2.0.

Tess (QA): I can run the extended perf pack but need ~12m. If we take 8m canary, can we extend to 12m?

Nina (Release Lead): prefer to stick to short window but can extend canary +1 if initial metrics look shaky. Priority: avoid wholesale skip.

Liam (PM): customers in EU are seeing notable slowdown. If it helps to speed up, I'm fine with an expedited approval and tighter monitoring. :+1:

Alex (SRE): +1 for readiness (infra checks green).

Tess (QA): running perf pack now: `./tools/perf/run --env eu --suite embed-smoke --duration 12m`

Ravi (ML): quick note: fallback path exists that serves un-cached embeddings (will be slower). Rollback safe.

Liam (PM): can someone draft a 1-line release note for #release-announce? "Fix: reduce embedding cache TTL regression causing higher latency in EU."

Nina (Release Lead): pin command: `releaser pin --env eu-dedicated --version v2.2.1-embed-latency --reason \"embed latency regression\" --rollback ab12cd3`

DeployBot: Approval count: 1/3.

Ravi (ML): /approve (from ML)

Tess (QA): /approve (after perf smoke looks good so far at 3m)

Alex (SRE): /approve (infra and dashboards look stable)

DeployBot: Approval count: 3/3. Initiating canary rollout (7% for 8m).

DeployBot: Canary minute-4 report: p50=15ms p95=210ms p99=340ms, errors=0.5% (transient).

Tess (QA): perf pack shows p95 trending down now, initial spike cleared after cache warm-up.

Nina (Release Lead): hold 2m to watch p99. If p99 falls under 400ms and errors <=1% we'll promote.

DeployBot: Canary minute-8 report: p50=14ms p95=120ms p99=190ms, errors=0.1%. No customer-visible regressions detected.

Nina (Release Lead): promoting to 100% now. Final release note: "hotfix(v2.2.1): fix for embedding cache TTL regression resolving elevated EU latency". Liam please queue announcement.

Liam (PM): queued to #release-announce for 08:00 UTC with the note.

AlertBot: Reminder set for 00:15 UTC to validate post-rollout dashboards.

DeployBot: Deploy finished: release/v2.2.1-embed-latency promoted to eu-dedicated (100%). Rollback target remains v2.2.0 (ab12cd3). Logs: <https://deploy.redwood.internal/logs/1719027777|view logs>.

Alex (SRE): leaving monitoring watch until 01:00 UTC. If anything recurs we rollback to ab12cd3.

Ravi (ML): adding a short note in the changelog and linking the PR: <https://github.com/redwood/embeddings/762|PR #762>.

Tess (QA): will add perf graphs to the ticket for postmortem.

Nina (Release Lead): thanks all. archiving thread."
